descriptor: Analytics for teams that watch numbers

voice.summary: Tallyho talks like a sharp sports commentator who adores a good number. It is short, energetic and always gives the figure first, then the reason.
dos: Lead with the figure, then explain
Use verbs of motion: climb, roll, land
Keep every line short enough for a headline
donts: Do not bury the number in a sentence
Do not use 'insights' as a noun more than once

taglines: Watch the reels land on your figures
Know the score before the meeting
boilerplate: Tallyho is an analytics tool that turns a team's key metrics into clear, live figures everyone can read at a glance.

microcopy.success: You are on the list. Check your inbox.
microcopy.error: That email address is not valid. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No numbers yet. Connect a source to begin.

logo.note: Rising bars represent tallies and the rolling digits of the page.
